cases.name: Antinette "Toni" Keller
cases.about: She was a Northern Illinois University art student. She was a talented watercolor painter and nature lover. "She painted flowers and landscapes," (her cousin Mary) Tarling said. "She loves camping and rock climbing."
cases.narrative: On 10/16/2010, her charred remains were found. Police also found Keller's burned clothing and her cell phone nearby.

cases.name: Gracie Sasso-Cleveland
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Gracie was born, September 14, 2007 in Aurora, IL. Daughter of Ericka Lynn Sasso and Billy Cleveland Jr. Her adopted father Juan De Dios Sandoval-Gutierrez.

Her two sisters Heaven Garcia and Nikki Sasso and grandparents loved her deeply. Gracie had many friends and touched the lives of all who knew her.

She was an outgoing person who loved music. She knew how to play piano and violin. She was a self-taught artist who loved to draw. Gracie loved her pets. She was an animal lover, no matter the type of animal which is why she wanted to be a veterinarian.

She was loved by her friends and cherished by her mother deeply. Gracie and Ericka would bond over long drives, by singing their favorite songs. Gracie could turn any negative energy into positive with a smile on her face. She had a kind and gentle spirit about her. Gracie’s wish for the future was to pursue beauty school and obtain a drivers license.

Gracie will be missed by family members and friends."
cases.narrative:
On 5/7/2023, her body was found in a dumpster on a property next to the 536 College Avenue, DeKalb, IL.
